paragraphs: Mentioned in Nedarim 38b: “It was taught: Yehoshua of Uza said,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading עיזא, Eiza, differs from body עוזא, Uza, also found in the older machine/catalog heading. No harmonization is made, and neither a genuine printed variant nor a transcription slip is established by this lane.

לח: gives Nedarim 38b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. The source Tanna classification, it-was-taught formula and etc. are preserved; no personal title is added.
